We have mass spectrum data: m/z values with intensities. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. The peaks likely correspond to isotopic envelope of a molecular ion. The base peak at 180.04225873612 (intensity 100). Then successive peaks at +1, +2, +3, etc with decreasing intensities. This pattern suggests presence of isotopes like 13C, 2H, 15N, 34S, etc. Need to determine which elements can be definitively identified from pattern.

We need isotopic distribution of common elements. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution tool.
